selection_rule: over every (variant, C, family weight): mean over the two validation sources (shakeleoatmeal/validation and the held-out family scenarios) of the AUC averaged over 10%..100% prefixes, using cross-fitted calibrated probabilities; settings within 0.005 of the best are tied and go to the simplest (no tactic count, then lower family weight, then smallest C)

calibration.fit_on: shakeleoatmeal/validation + held-out family scenarios, 10%..100% prefixes, equal weight per source

thresholds.rule: smallest p (3 decimals) such that at most 10% (yellow) / 2% (red) of non-scam calls EVER reach it at any 2% checkpoint; the strictest of training-pool out-of-fold, shakeleoatmeal/validation and the held-out family scenarios

test_in_strict.title: in-domain test, strict de-dup (no shared template >= 0.3)

family_test.title: family-emergency TEST batch (AI-written, separate writers and scenarios)

validation_reference.title: shakeleoatmeal validation (used for selection, calibration, thresholds)

validation_family_reference.title: held-out family scenarios (used for selection, calibration, thresholds)

main.text: I’m in real trouble. I got arrested and I need bail money tonight.
Oh no. Are you hurt? Let me call your mother.
Please don’t tell Mom. She can’t find out.
The lawyer says you can pay with gift cards from the pharmacy.
Can you go now? I only have a few minutes.
Hi Grandma, it’s Ethan. My phone died, so I’m using Jake’s.
Are we still on for pancakes Saturday? Mom said she’ll drive me over.
Nine works. Love you, see you then.

I missed the last bus. Could you send me money for a ride home?
Near the mall. I can explain later.
Okay. Let me call your dad and we’ll come get you.
